memo: Only one change helped: slot 15, DEPTH 8 to 7 with model_dim kept at 512. It scored 1.1077/1.1066 over 2 runs, and the incumbent is now mean_adjusted 1.1072. Architecture is the only family with an accepted win (a=2 b=4). Slot 12 (depth 6, aspect 96) was close at +0.0025. Slot 17 (aspect 80, head dim 64) lost at +0.0183. Slot 14 (lower beta1) was -0.0012 but was rejected, so it is within noise. Schedule, warmup, weight decay, Adam betas and SCALAR_LR changes all lost. Lowering UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.0001 was very bad at +0.4298. Batch 256 hit OOM and then lost at +0.0676. Slot 7 (batch 2**20) crashed, and slot 1 (UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.01) failed to patch and is untested. Next: try nearby depth and width variants, such as depth 7 with a different aspect ratio or a smaller device batch. Also try a modest UNEMBEDDING_LR increase, a higher weight decay than 0.2, a lower SCALAR_LR, and matrix and embedding LRs. Replicate any win before accepting it. Stop tuning the schedule.
